title: Slice execution order (mutable overlay over the gate-2 slice plan)
description: plan/slices.yaml is an ARRAY, so order is positional and gate-2 hashes it whole — reordering there costs a formal reopen and rewrites the hash dependent submodule pins consume. Gate 2 locks slice BOUNDARIES (features, depends_on, done_means); this file carries the SEQUENCE, which G3 calls the actual decision, and makes changing it a logged decision instead of a gate reopen. Written by scripts/sequence.py.

baseline.description: The order as it stood when gate-2 was locked. Never reordered afterwards — it is what makes drift measurable. sync only adds or removes ids alongside a gate-2 reopen.

order.description: The order being executed. Must be a permutation of plan/slices.yaml's ids and must satisfy every depends_on edge; validate.py checks both.

recorded.description: When this file was initialised, ISO 8601.
